Zebra Technologies

Zebra Design System

An enterprise utility language: calm, precise and built for frontline workers who scan screens quickly, often on rugged handhelds, with gloves on or in bad light. Cool-neutral greys, one confident Zebra Blue, hairline borders and IBM Plex Sans.

paletteSingle blue accent contrastLight · dark · AAA check_circleWCAG AA / AAA

—icons

Colour

Semantic colour tokens by family. Values shown are live: switch Dark or AAA contrast in the header and every swatch re-resolves through the same token name.

Typography

IBM Plex Sans throughout. Display sizes use the light weight; titles and labels use medium. Headings h1–h6 alias heading-large … title-small.

Spacing, shape & depth

Everything snaps to the 4px grid unit. Every component is rounded by default; the AAA contrast modes make every component sharp, except true circles such as a radio ring, switch track or avatar. Depth comes from hairline borders and very soft cool-grey shadows.

Date Picker

Select a date, a range, a week or a time, either by typing in the date input or by picking from the calendar popover. The calendar grid is arrow-key navigable (arrows move by day and week, Page Up/Down by month). Today is marked with an outline and bold number, not colour alone. Use the calendar icon in a field to reopen its popover. Mock “today” is 6 November 2026.

Draft component: measurements are provisional until the component has a Figma source. The popover is shown inline instead of floating.
